discoveries.observation: claude-print adapter: stream-json needs --verbose; total_cost_usd ignored; variadic tool flags swallowed the prompt

discoveries.observation: Side-effect guard is argv classification + transcript scan + diff scope, not a sandbox
discoveries.proposedEdit: State the limitation in #176 AC and route through an approved experiment sandbox when present
discoveries.publicSummary: Guardrails block declared commands and detect attempts, but do not sandbox network egress

discoveries.observation: No Supabase credentials: only the auth-bypass demo board is runnable; mission journeys (capture/resume/today) unevaluable

discoveries.observation: Pre-freeze check dry-run and the independent UX critic both changed the contract materially

discoveries.publicSummary: The critic and a pre-freeze check dry-run caught wrong assumptions before implementation

discoveries.observation: One-shot builder ignored the permitted fallback; it cannot see frozen check results
discoveries.proposedEdit: Allow read-only frozen-check runs by the builder and one bounded repair round under the same contract version; decision stays independent
discoveries.publicSummary: Builder had no executable feedback; add bounded repair under the frozen contract

discoveries.observation: Conditional hypotheses are ambiguous to builders
discoveries.proposedEdit: Contracts name one intended change; fallbacks are required or separate cycles
discoveries.publicSummary: Contracts should name one intended change

discoveries.observation: Host-role cost unknown; token counts wrong; no durable private home for run evidence
discoveries.proposedEdit: Adapters for scout/contract writer; aggregate usage from result event; choose a durable private evidence store (human decision)
discoveries.publicSummary: Cost and evidence durability gaps in the improvement trace

discoveries.observation: improve is not a runner loop or tier route; thin tickets block production build
